1v1 yoki 2v2: ELO har bir tasdiqlangan uchrashuv boʻyicha hisoblanadi: kuchli raqib ustidan gʻalaba koʻproq ochko beradi, quruq hisobdagi seriya esa undan ham koʻp. Dastlabki 10 uchrashuvda reyting tezroq oʻzgaradi.
1v1 or 2v2: ELO is updated after every confirmed match: beating a stronger opponent earns more points, and a sweep earns even more. Ratings move faster during your first 10 matches.

1v1 or 2v2: Seed by ELO: confirmed entries get seeds by their players’ average rating, so the strongest don’t meet early.
